name: ainotate
description: Annotated screenshots for AI agents: numbered steps, Skitch-style arrows, boxes, labels and solid redaction, placed where they cover the least content. Skill plus MCP server.

args: PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; if command -v ainotate >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec ainotate mcp; else exec uvx --from 'ainotate[all]' ainotate mcp; fi
